description: Declares a signal input with a default value: `size = input('small')`. Read it with `size()`.
Declares an input every parent must bind; missing bindings are template compile errors. Reading it before binding throws NG0950.
`input(false, { transform: booleanAttribute })` converts the incoming value. Angular ships `booleanAttribute` and `numberAttribute`.
`input('', { alias: 'publicName' })` binds under a different name in templates.
`host: { '[class.x]': 'expr()' }` binds properties, classes and styles on the component's own element.
Legacy decorator input: a mutable property, typically combined with `ngOnChanges` or setters.
